adultGuidance: Let your child pick one real small moment, a walk, a snack, a game, a visit. Read the story together, help them add one detail, and celebrate the writing. This pack builds two Grade 1 writing goals: writing a narrative with events in order, details, time words, and a closing (W.1.3), and focusing on a topic and adding details to strengthen writing (W.1.5). If your child cannot think of a moment, offer two of your own small moments and let them choose one.
description: Plan a small moment, tell it in order, add details, write the story, and revise it.
learningFocus: Plan a small moment in order, with a Beginning, a Middle, and an End.
Tell the moment in order using First, Next, and Last.
Add details about who was there, where it happened, and how it felt.
Write the story independently on open lines, with a picture to match.
Revise the story by adding one more detail.
